description: This file defines mock classes and utilities for DNS host resolution used in testing, including mock resolvers, rule-based resolvers, and related classes.

classes.name: MockHostResolverBase
classes.description: Base class for mock host resolvers, providing rule-based resolution and request management.

classes.name: MockHostResolver
classes.description: Mock resolver that does not use caching, for testing purposes.

classes.name: MockCachingHostResolver
classes.description: Mock resolver with internal caching, for testing cache behavior.

classes.name: MockHostResolverFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create mock (caching) host resolvers.

classes.name: RuleBasedHostResolverProc
classes.description: HostResolverProc implementation that applies rules to map hostnames to IP literals.

classes.name: HangingHostResolver
classes.description: Resolver that never completes its resolution requests, used for testing timeouts and cancellations.

classes.name: ScopedDefaultHostResolverProc
classes.description: Utility to set a default host resolver proc within a scope.

methods.name: ParseAddressList
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated list of IPv4 or IPv6 literals into address endpoints.

methods.name: RuleResolver::AddRule
methods.description: Adds a rule to resolve a hostname pattern to an IP literal or error.

methods.name: RuleResolver::Resolve
methods.description: Resolves a request endpoint based on the rules.

methods.name: MockHostResolver::LoadIntoCache
methods.description: Preloads cache with specified endpoint and parameters.

methods.name: MockHostResolver::CreateRequest
methods.description: Creates a resolution request for a hostname.

methods.name: RuleBasedHostResolverProc::AddRule
methods.description: Adds a hostname pattern to IP literal rule.

methods.name: RuleBasedHostResolverProc::AddRuleForAddressFamily
methods.description: Adds a hostname pattern to IP literal rule with address family restriction.

methods.name: RuleBasedHostResolverProc::AddRuleWithFlags
methods.description: Adds a hostname pattern with specific flags.

methods.name: RuleBasedHostResolverProc::AddIPLiteralRule
methods.description: Adds a hostname pattern mapped directly to an IP literal.

methods.name: HangingHostResolver::CreateRequest
methods.description: Creates a request that never completes, for testing.
